narrative_purpose: Makes the eclipse beat physical: a gas giant blotting out the working day on a schedule, the canopy thrown into shadow, and the glow strengthening while fixation stops and reserves burn.
subject: An enormous banded gas giant filling much of the upper sky, its limb sliding across and blotting out a small bright sun so only a thin crescent of direct light remains at its edge. Below it, the upper surface of a violet forest canopy lies in deep shadow, and along the veins and undersides of the topmost leaves a cold cyan bioluminescence has strengthened into visible glowing lines and patches.
scene: A view across the top of the canopy from just above it, the forest receding into hazy distance below, the gas giant dominating overhead at the moment of occultation.
camera: A wide elevated view looking slightly upward across the canopy toward the eclipsing planet, canopy in the lower third and sky above.
light: Direct light almost entirely cut off — only a thin rim of pale light at the planet's edge and a dim red-shifted wash refracted around it; the canopy's own cyan and teal bioluminescence is now the dominant light in the frame.
palette: Void-indigo sky and deep teal-indigo canopy shadow dominating; the gas giant rendered in dark desaturated stone and deep teal bands; glow in Pandora cyan and living teal; one thin restrained ember-amber rim where light refracts past the planet's edge.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, atmospheric and observed.
detail_level: Crisp on the glowing leaf veins in the near canopy and on the planet's limb; mid and far canopy soft and hazy.
composition: Canopy across the lower third, the gas giant's curve occupying the upper left and centre, a broad dark quiet region of sky to the right for overlaid callouts.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette; the frame must feel like light being taken away rather than like night — the sky is still daytime-hazy, just occluded.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no leader lines, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no vector flat design
